reddit.title: Improving Music Transitions in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to the music transitions in Provincia! The day, night, title, and combat beds now feature smooth crossfades instead of abrupt cuts. This enhancement ensures a more immersive experience as you build and manage your colony. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops

steam.title: Audio Improvements in Provincia
steam.body: We're excited to announce that the music in Provincia has been upgraded for a smoother experience! Transitions between day, night, title, and combat beds are now seamless with long equal-power crossfades. Enjoy a more immersive atmosphere as you manage your colony. Read more about this update on our devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
